tracks.title: Content Studio
tracks.summary: Run your social content from one place: content pages per channel, Content Intelligence for your reels, and the CMO agent.
tracks.overview:
**Content Studio** is the social content workspace. It adds two pages under **Content › Content Studio**, plus a team of content agents.

- **Pages** (`/content-pages`). A content page is one surface: an Instagram account, a YouTube channel, a blog, a newsletter. Creating one provisions its **Scripts**, **Videos**, **Content** and **Ideas** databases, and each page has insights and connections. Instagram is connected with a Graph API token and ManyChat with an API key; ManyChat only shows *connected* after ManyChat has verified the key.
- **Intelligence** (`/content-intel`). Import your Instagram CSV export from Meta Business Suite, then transcribe reels, **score** them (hook, value, viral) against viral-format benchmarks for your niche, and read AI insights, scripts and trends.
- **The CMO.** A Chief Marketing Officer agent you can chat with, grounded in your reel data. The plugin also seeds a content director, scriptwriter, brand designer and video editor agent.

The tours open dialogs and type into drafts only. They never create a page, import data, score reels (scoring calls a model) or send a message. Nothing here posts or publishes to a social network.

walkthroughs.title: Set up a content page
walkthroughs.summary: Find your pages, filter them, and walk through the new-page wizard.

steps.title: Your content pages
steps.body: One page per surface: an Instagram account, a YouTube channel, a blog. Each card shows the page's reach at a glance.

steps.title: Find a page
steps.body: Search by name, then narrow by business or surface with the two filters beside it.

steps.title: Filter by surface
steps.body: Show only Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, a blog, LinkedIn and so on.

steps.title: Start a new page
steps.body: Click **New page** to open the setup wizard.

steps.title: The wizard's steps
steps.body: Basics, Goals, Connections and Brand voice. Instagram pages add an **Instagram** step and an optional **ManyChat** step for DM automation.

steps.title: Name the page
steps.body: Type a name. You also pick the surface, handle, URL, business and an optional owner agent here.

steps.title: What Create page does
steps.body: On the last step, **Create page** saves the page and provisions its Scripts, Videos, Content and Ideas databases. Connect Instagram afterwards from the page's **Integrations** tab.

steps.title: Close the wizard
steps.body: Click **×** to leave without creating anything.

walkthroughs.title: Content Intelligence
walkthroughs.summary: Bring your reels in, then score, transcribe and read insights.

steps.title: Open Intelligence
steps.body: Content Studio has two views: **Pages** and **Intelligence**. Click **Intelligence**.

steps.title: Start with your data
steps.body: Intelligence analyses your own reels. Until you import some, this is the starting point.

steps.title: Import an Instagram CSV
steps.body: Export your reels as CSV from Meta Business Suite, then import it here by file path on the gateway machine, optionally for one account. **Accounts** and **YouTube** in the header add more sources.

steps.title: Score and transcribe
steps.body: Once reels are in, **Transcribe** writes a script for each one and **Score all** rates hook, value and viral potential, then ranks it against viral-format benchmarks for your niche. Filter by scored, unscored or no script, and sort by views, saves, score or tier.

practice.note: The tour doesn't start scoring or transcription: both run on your model and speech providers.

steps.title: Overview, Scripts, Insights, Trends
steps.body: **Overview** is the reel grid with charts. **Scripts** lists transcribed, scored reels. **AI Insights** summarises what works. **Trends** shows topics, formats and signals from the last 30 days.

walkthroughs.title: Talk to your CMO
walkthroughs.summary: Open agent chat, switch to the Chief Marketing Officer and draft a question.

steps.title: Open agent chat
steps.body: Click **Chat** in the command bar. On a phone it sits under **More** (⋯). The shortcut is **⌘⇧M**.

steps.title: Chat with an agent
steps.body: Pick **Chat with an agent**.

steps.title: Switch agent
steps.body: The header shows which agent you're talking to. Click it to switch.

steps.title: Find the CMO
steps.body: Type **cmo**.

steps.title: Pick the CMO
steps.body: Click **Chief Marketing Officer**. Content Studio adds this agent while the plugin is on.

steps.title: Ask for ideas
steps.body: Draft a question about growth, hooks or a new script. The CMO works from your live reel data.

action.sample: Give me three hook ideas for next week

steps.title: Sending the message
steps.body: **Enter** sends it and the CMO replies here. The same chat is embedded on the Intelligence page once you have reels.

practice.note: The tour doesn't send: a reply runs the agent on your model provider.

steps.title: Close chat
steps.body: Click **×** or press **Esc**. The conversation history stays with the agent.

options: A blog post draft
One surface, such as an Instagram account or YouTube channel, with its own Scripts, Videos, Content and Ideas databases
A Notion page mirrored into InfiniBot
A landing page Content Studio publishes for you
quiz.explain: Creating a page provisions its four databases, and each page carries its own insights and connections.

quiz.prompt: How do your reels get into Content Intelligence?
options: Content Studio scrapes Instagram automatically
You import an Instagram CSV export from Meta Business Suite (or add YouTube channels)
You paste reel links into chat
They are synced from TikTok
quiz.explain: The welcome screen starts with a CSV import; YouTube channels can be added from the header.

quiz.prompt: What does scoring a reel rate?
options: File size and resolution
Hook, value and viral potential, ranked against viral-format benchmarks
Only the number of views
Spelling in the caption
quiz.explain: Scores cover hook, value and viral, and are compared with benchmarks for your niche.

quiz.prompt: Where can you chat with the CMO agent?
options: Only on Telegram
Through agent chat (switch to Chief Marketing Officer) and inline on the Intelligence page
Nowhere, it only runs on a schedule
In Settings › Models
quiz.explain: The CMO is a regular agent you can pick in agent chat; the Intelligence page embeds the same chat.

quiz.prompt: What happens to your content data if you turn Content Studio off?
options: It is deleted
It stays where it is and comes back when you turn the plugin on again
It is exported to Notion
It is moved to the trash for 30 days
quiz.explain: Disabling hides the pages, RPCs and agents but never deletes data.
